movelist.name: Jump Kick
movelist.effect: If Jump Kick misses, the user loses Hit Points equal to 1/4th of their Max Hit Points. A failure to hit due to a Move with the Shield keyword does not count as a miss. This Move cannot be used if Gravity is in effect.

movelist.name: Drain Punch
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains HP equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Force Palm
movelist.effect: Force Palm Paralyzes the target on 18+.

movelist.name: Calm Mind
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Regenerator
abilities.trigger: The user is recalled into a Poké Ball, or Takes
abilities.effect: The user gains Hit Points equal to 1/3rd of its maximum Hit Points. Regenerator may be activated only once per Scene.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.effect: The user cannot be Flinched, and their Initiative cannot be unwillingly lowered by any effects.

abilities.name: Reckless
abilities.effect: Increases the Damage Base of Moves with the Exhaust, Recoil, or Reckless Keywords by +3. Reckless Moves: Jump Kick, Hi Jump Kick, Close Combat, Draco Meteor, Hammer Arm, Leaf Storm, Outrage, Overheat, Petal Dance, Psycho Boost, Superpower, Thrash, and V-Create.
